findings.summary: readTaskOnMain reads the local origin/main ref, and nothing in dispatch.ts fetches it before reconcile. The hook runs only on the first merged observation, so if the local origin/main lags the merge the enqueue is silently skipped and never retried. Manual brief --notify still covers it. Fetch origin/main before the lookup, or retry while eligible and not on the board.

findings.summary: Not a vulnerability. Anyone who can get a PR merged under an ai-sdlc/file-<id> branch can trigger an auto-enqueue, but the effect is bounded: it fires only on merged PRs, eligibility is read from origin/main, and a task already on the board is skipped. Optionally also confirm the PR changed the matching backlog task file.
